_comment: Release notes settle the modelling: the trigger fires and resolves during the start-of-turn phase with no priority, and 'target hero' is chosen at trigger time, not when played. START_OF_TURN is dispatched to the turn player's permanent zones incl. auras (engine.py:1461-1466), so the aura sees its own controller's start phase as printed ('At the start of your turn'). Trigger-time targeting is approximated by a resolution-time CHOOSE between SELF and OPPONENT - equivalent here because the ability resolves immediately in the start phase with no intervening priority; GAIN reads player (effect_types.py:4795) and resolves it via _effect_player_id. LIMITATION: in a multiplayer game 'target hero' means ANY hero, but CHOOSE here offers only the two heroes of a two-player game; no DSL shape found for an arbitrary-player target on a triggered layer (triggered-layer target declaration is a known engine gap). Destroy-then-gain order matches the printed text; effects run sequentially and the ability resolves fully even though the source left play.
